protocol.study: Training-only investigation of crop information beyond PCA component 4
protocol.hypothesis: Low-variance components 5-8 may carry crop-discriminative information omitted by leading-variance PCA compression; additional standardized PCs may instead amplify irrelevant variation.
protocol.data: 914 original training fields only; no validation/test predictions, scoring or selection

views.pca13: full PCA + unit-variance PC scaling; controls for discarded components
views.raw13: StandardScaler on the original 13 features; controls for whitening/reweighting
views.late5_8: PCA(8) then retain only standardized PCs 5-8; tests whether later PCs alone are predictive
views.selected4of8: PCA(8) + unit-variance PC scaling + SelectKBest(f_classif, k=4); labels and transforms fitted inside each fold

learners.logistic: LogisticRegression C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=3000, tol=1e-6; deterministic
learners.svm_fixed: organizer SVC C=100, gamma=0.01, unmodified for every view
learners.svm_nested: same SVC; inner-training-only grid C=[1,10,100], gamma=[0.01,0.1,scale]

protocol.selection: mean of three repeat-specific pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 scores for nested SVM; exact ties favor fewer output features
protocol.paired_comparisons: same fields and outer folds for every representation and learner; report all repeats and crop precision/recall
protocol.descriptive_analysis: complete full-training PCA, loadings, feature distributions and label separation are exploratory; they are never substituted for fold-fitted transformations
protocol.quantum_decision: Do not increase qubit count based on variance alone. Require consistent incremental predictive evidence; consider four selected inputs before six/eight qubits. Any quantum comparison is separately explained and preregistered after this study.
limitations: training spatial identifiers unavailable; CV is not spatial
repeat folds overlap and are not independent samples
classical gains do not guarantee QNN gains
PCA component signs can flip and are not physical crop effects
